init_whisper_model: initialize a Whisper ASR model with a given model tag like large on CUDA or CPU
transcribe_series: transcribe a pandas Series of audio file paths using a Whisper model and return transcriptions
whisper_normalize_series: normalize a pandas Series of text transcriptions using Whisper normalizers for a given language
compute_asr_bleu: compute corpus-level ASR-BLEU score by transcribing audio paths and comparing against reference text
compute_corpus_bleu: compute corpus-level BLEU score between hypothesis text and reference text with optional Whisper normalization
